name: The Struck Name
pitch: Each second you scrape the name off the enemy's arts, their tag modifiers stop working, and you wear what you took: the bigger the specialist, the faster they die.

new.name: Struck Name

new.name: Bare hit
new.effect: A hit with no kind and no tags. Combat rule 4, Formulas C and D.

questions: Should a curse be able to block a whole tag family? Rule 8 allows blocking a tag, and this build needs the wider version.
Is it right that a plain fighter with no L2 beats this build while a stronger specialist loses to it?
A bare hit needs a fallback in Formulas D. Default ward terms are the first guess: is that the reading you want?
